title: ainsliaea henryi var. subalpina
intro: Ainsliaea henryi var. subalpina, commonly known as a type of flowering plant, is a variant of the Ainsliaea henryi species native to specific mountainous regions. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, making it useful in alleviating symptoms of various health conditions. The therapeutic actions of Ainsliaea henryi var. subalpina include inhibiting the growth of certain microorganisms and exhibiting analgesic and anti-fever effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenes and triterpenes, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
